verdict: Yes. Wit Blox pitched modular kids' playing equipment on Shark Tank India Season 1 and got a deal. Parents want safe indoor play options for small city homes, and schools and play areas buy in bulk.
angle: Modular play frames, climbing sets and building kits sell to parents, schools and playschools. Safety certification under BIS toy standards is mandatory. Bulky products are expensive to ship, so flat-pack design helps.
